text:
emily: Published the incident summary and investigation for the serving slowdown earlier today — INC-2026-342 is live: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-342. TL;DR: transient autoscaler regression + unexpected KV cache pressure. Full timeline, root cause analysis, and mitigations are in the doc. Please review and pick owners for actions.

carlos: link works, thanks. quick Q — which items are highest priority?

emily: Priority = prevent recurrence first (autoscaler + gating), then reduce blast radius (cache guardrails), then compliance signoff. I added an initial action list in the doc. Short version below.

emily: ```
1) Autoscaler hotfix + unit/integration tests — owner: mike — due: 2026-03-29
2) Cache eviction guardrails & limits — owner: carlos — due: 2026-04-05
3) Rollout gating for autoscaler changes (canary + perf gates) — owner: platform-qa — due: 2026-04-12
4) Compliance/incident writeup + audit artifacts — owner: jen — due: 2026-04-02
```

jen: thanks — I'll take compliance and the audit artifacts. I'll need a short summary from the oncall timeline to attach.

mike: I'll open the autoscaler hotfix PR this afternoon and include the unit test change. pinging @platform-qa for the canary gating tests.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-342 status update: RCA_published by emily — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-342 (automated)

carlos: I'll prototype the cache guardrail config and a small e2e to validate eviction thresholds. will post progress in #eng-runtime.

jen: can we schedule a 1hr checkpoint next week to validate owners' progress and unblock anything? prefer Wed 10:00 PT.

emily: Scheduled: Wed 2026-03-31 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent to @eng-sre, @platform, @compliance. Please add blockers to the doc before the meeting.

carlos: note for the meeting — we should include a perf bench step before canary rollout, otherwise we might regress cost/latency. :warning:

mike: added perf bench step to my PR checklist. thanks for flagging.

emily: Thanks everyone. Please update the action table in the doc as you make progress (status, link to PR, ETA). I'll follow up on outstanding items in the Wed check-in. :white_check_mark:
